newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: US takes 48 pct of Singapore multimedia exports.
newsitem.headline: US takes 48 pct of Singapore multimedia exports.

text.p: The United States accounted for 48 percent of Singapore's total domestic exports of multimedia and computer related products between January and September 1996, Singapore's Trade Development Board (TDB) said on Sunday.

In the nine-month period, two-way trade between Singapore and the U.S. for multimedia and computer-related products, including CD-ROM drives, hard disk drives and video and sound cards, reached Singapore $17.5 billion, a 16 percent rise over the same period in 1995, TDB said in a statement.
It said domestic exports of such products to the US alone recorded about a 19 percent rise in that period, amounting to S$13.3 billion.
"This amount also accounted for 48 percent of Singapore's total domestic exports of such products to the world in the same period," TDB said.
